title: facebookresearch/metamotivo
abstract:
The first behavioral foundation model to control a virtual physics-based humanoid agent for a wide range of whole-body tasks.

# Meta Motivo **[Meta, FAIR](https://ai.facebook.com/research/)** # Overview This repository provides a PyTorch implementation and pre-trained models for Meta Motivo. For details see the paper [Zero-Shot Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Behavioral Foundation Models](https://metamotivo.metademolab.com/). ### Features - We provide [**6** pretrained FB-CPR](https://huggingface.co/collections/facebook/meta-motivo-6757761e8fd4a032466fd129) models for controlling the humanoid model defined in [HumEnv](https://github.com/facebookresearch/HumEnv/). - **Fully reproducible** scripts for evaluating the model in HumEnv. - **Fully reproducible** [FB-CPR training code in HumEnv](examples/fbcpr_train_humenv.py) for the full results in the paper, and [FB training code in DMC](examples/fb_train_dmc.py) for faster experimentation. # Installation The project is pip installable in your environment. It requires Python 3.10+. Optional dependencies include `humenv["bench"]` and `huggingface_hub` for testing/training and loading models from HuggingFace. # Pretrained models For reproducibility, we provide all the **5** models (**metamotivo-S-X**) we trained for producing the results in the [paper](https://openreview.net/forum?id=9sOR0nYLtz&referrer=%5BAuthor%20Console%5D(%2Fgroup%3Fid%3DICLR.cc%2F2025%2FConference%2FAuthors%23your-submissions)), where each model is trained using a different random seed. We also provide our largest and most performant model (**metamotivo-M-1**), which can also be interactively tested in our [demo](https://metamotivo.metademolab.com/). | Model | # of params | Download | | :--- | :---: | :---: | | metamotivo-S-1 | 24.5M | [link](https://huggingface.co/facebook/metamotivo-S-1) | | metamotivo-S-2 | 24.5M | [link](https://huggingface.co/facebook/metamotivo-S-2) | | metamotivo-S-3 | 24.5M | [link](https://huggingface.co/facebook/metamotivo-S-3) | | metamotivo-S-4 | 24.5M | [link](https://huggingface.co/facebook/metamotivo-S-4) | | metamotivo-S-5 | 24.5M | [link](ht
abstract_zh: Meta Motivo 是首个行为基础模型，能够控制基于物理的虚拟人形智能体，完成多种全身任务。本仓库提供了 PyTorch 实现和预训练模型。我们提供了 6 个预训练的 FB-CPR 模型，用于控制 HumEnv 中定义的人形模型，并包含完全可复现的评估和训练脚本。所有模型均可在 HuggingFace 上下载。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出Meta Motivo，一个行为基础模型，通过FB-CPR算法在HumEnv物理环境中进行无监督预训练，学习运动表示，从而零样本控制虚拟人形智能体完成多种全身任务。


# 一、动机

> 现有的人形全身控制方法通常需要针对每个任务单独训练，缺乏能够泛化到多种全身任务的单一行为基础模型。


# 二、方法

> 提出Meta Motivo，一个行为基础模型，通过FB-CPR算法在HumEnv物理环境中进行无监督预训练，学习运动表示，从而零样本控制虚拟人形智能体完成多种全身任务。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 提供了5个可复现的S系列模型（参数量24.5M）和1个性能更强的M模型，在ICLR 2025论文中展示了零样本全身控制能力，并公开了训练和评估代码。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题相关，但局限于虚拟环境，向真实机器人迁移仍需解决sim-to-real问题；其行为基础模型思路可为机器人全身控制提供预训练起点。
